adaptive.description: Adaptive mode: adjust the sensitivity while mouse and keyboard are in use. Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

background.description: Run hdapsd in the background as a daemon. Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

device.description: Device to protect ("sda"), or a list of devices — autodetected when unset. Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

pidfile.description: Write a pid file at this path. Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

sensitivity.description: How sensitive hdapsd is (the daemon's default is 15). Unset keeps the shipped commented line.

syslog.description: Log to syslog. Unset keeps the shipped commented line.
